bundleInvariant.physicalExplanation: five owner DDL units plus two physical contracts plus the self-sealed generation report

controls: exact eight-file canonical and exact eight-file physical directory boundaries reject missing, extra, symlink and non-regular entries
candidate files are opened with O_NOFOLLOW and stable path/descriptor device, inode, mode, size, mtime_ns, ctime_ns and SHA-256 identity checks
the immutable self-sealed promotion spec contains the exact ordered source/destination manifest, every candidate identity and every destination compare-and-swap precondition

a strict self-sealed independent acceptance report must bind both exact candidate hash maps and PASS canonical static, hostile, physical, PostgreSQL 16, PostgreSQL 18, normalized equality, source stability, reader-fence coverage and journal recovery checks
the physical generation report must self-seal, bind the canonical directory and all eight canonical hashes, and bind all seven generated physical payload hashes
all candidate sources, destinations, transaction staging, backups, journal and immutable receipt are required on one filesystem
staged and backup bytes are fsynced before PREPARED; journal and renamed destination parents are fsynced; the immutable receipt uses create-new hard-link publication
the common hris-verification semaphore and same-thread opaque capability are mandatory for production promotion and recovery
PREPARED, COMMITTING and FINALIZING journal phases block central consumers; only exact terminal journals permit them
destination identity is checked immediately before each atomic rename and the complete successor generation is checked again before receipt publication
candidate identity is rechecked after staging and again after all destination renames
recovery first classifies every destination as predecessor, accepted successor or foreign; any foreign generation refuses destructive rollback

an interrupted partial transaction restores predecessor bytes and modes, while a crash after exact immutable receipt publication finalizes only when all sixteen destinations are the accepted successor
Gate must remain exact CLOSED_FAIL_SAFE and every receipt preserves NOT_AUTHORIZED_G6
specs, preflight reports and promotion receipts are create-new and cannot overwrite historical evidence

coveredHostileCases: crash after first destination install with exact rollback
crash after receipt publication with exact commit finalization
successful exact sixteen-file commit in an isolated fixture

sourceOnlyMutationProof.method: SHA-256 snapshot before and after compile plus both self-tests

limitationsAndRequiredNextGate: This author report is not independent acceptance and cannot authorize promotion.
No production candidate spec was prepared and no live promotion, rollback or recovery was executed.

POSIX provides no single rename for sixteen independent pathnames; no-mixed-generation safety therefore requires the common semaphore plus the fail-closed journal fence for every supported reader. Independent review must prove reader-fence coverage before issuing the required acceptance evidence.

The transition plan text that says six physical artifacts is stale relative to the current v4 physical generator. Promotion is deliberately blocked unless the exact eight-file physical candidate, including split SYS auth/platform DDL and the generation report, is accepted.
The eventual qualified bundle requires an independently self-sealed acceptance report with all nine exact PASS checks before --prepare-spec can succeed.
The production promotion must be separately audited and invoked only after the fresh canonical and physical candidates are independently accepted; Gate opening remains a later, separate transaction.
